work_or_witness: Black Clover, Vol. 1, VIZ English digital edition
description: A young boy born without magic ability in a world where magic is central. He seeks to become the Wizard King to prove his strength and keep a promise with his friend; VIZ's Volume 1 editorial coverage says an unusual grimoire gives him a sword that negates magic.

roles_and_vocations.note: Directly stated in VIZ's Volume 1 product synopsis; no achieved office is asserted.

power_traditions.note: VIZ's Volume 1 product synopsis describes Asta as born without magic ability; this is fictional setting framing, not a real-world diagnosis.
VIZ's official Volume 1 editorial review describes the unusual sword as negating magic. Detailed mechanics are not mapped.

artifacts_and_vehicles.note: VIZ's official Volume 1 editorial review says Asta receives it; no later lore or exact classification is imported.

narrative_archetypes.note: A cautious narrative label based on the stated no-magic premise and goal.

canon_status: Synopsis-level character in the selected VIZ English Volume 1 witness.

supports: Asta is young, born with no magic ability, and aims to become Wizard King to prove his strength and keep a promise with a friend.
Asta's friend/rival Yuno, unusual grimoire, and magic-negating sword framing.
